props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether several items can be open at once.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which arrow keys move between triggers: Up/Down when vertical, Left/Right when horizontal.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether the arrow keys wrap around at the ends.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

props.name: value
props.description: Identifies the item in the root's `value`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Its trigger does nothing while disabled. Find-in-page still opens it: the browser's behaviour wins.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called before the root's `onValueChange` when the item is opened or closed.

parts.name: AccordionTrigger
parts.description: Spread on a <summary> that is the first child of the item's <details>: the toggling, focusability and the expanded state come from that element, and it works on no other. A press asks the root instead of toggling, so a controlled `value` decides and the close can animate. The arrow keys, Home and End move between triggers.

parts.name: AccordionPanel
parts.description: A region labelled by its trigger. Its size is written to `--accordion-panel-height` and `--accordion-panel-width`: px while it opens and closes, `auto` once open. Animate `height` from 0 with both `details:not([open]) > .panel` and `@starting-style` (Chrome needs the second, Safari the first), and to 0 under `[data-ending-style]`.
